**Subject: Grant Application – Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC) for Sacramento Community Gun Safety**

Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC) respectfully requests support from the Sacramento Stockton Blvd Grant to address the critical need for comprehensive gun safety education in Sacramento’s communities of color. Accidental shootings and gun-related incidents disproportionately affect these neighborhoods, often due to a lack of accessible, culturally relevant information. GAFC, a proud minority-owned social enterprise, is uniquely positioned to deliver this vital education.

Our innovative programs engage residents of all ages. The "Gloxsie 21" cartoon IP provides foundational gun safety principles in an engaging, youth-friendly format, fostering early awareness. Our AI education initiative leverages technology to deliver personalized safety scenarios and resources, making learning interactive and relevant. Complementing these, our direct community workshops, often hosted in partnership with the esteemed Church of Legacy, offer hands-on training and open dialogue, building trust and practical skills among families and gun owners.

With your investment, GAFC will significantly expand its reach, directly impacting over 1,000 residents annually. Outcomes will include increased knowledge of safe gun storage, proper handling, and conflict de-escalation, ultimately leading to a measurable reduction in accidental shootings and improved community well-being. GAFC's leadership comprises individuals deeply rooted in Sacramento's communities of color, ensuring our curriculum resonates authentically and effectively. Our partnership with the Church of Legacy further strengthens our grassroots connection and capacity for sustained impact.

We seek $20,000 from the Sacramento Stockton Blvd Grant to scale our program delivery, develop more "Gloxsie 21" content, and expand our AI educational platform. This investment will empower GAFC to build safer homes and stronger communities along the Sacramento Stockton Boulevard corridor and beyond. Thank you for considering our application.
